description: User-facing search behavior: what people search for, how often, in what language, and what they fail to find. Reads directly from sn_site_metric_access (TurSNSiteMetricAccess).

panels.description: Total search events recorded in the selected time range. Each row in sn_site_metric_access is one user-issued query.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Total searches

panels.description: Distinct sanitized terms (case-insensitive, accent-stripped). Tells you the breadth of what users are looking for.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `sanatizedTerm`) AS unique_terms
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Unique terms

panels.description: Share of searches that returned zero results. High values point to demand the catalog isn't covering — every percentage point is a content opportunity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN `numFound` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS zero_result_rate
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Zero-result rate

panels.description: Distinct user IDs that searched in the period. Empty userId rows count as anonymous and are merged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(`userId`, ''), 'anonymous')) AS users
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')

panels.title: Active users

panels.description: Search volume over time. Look for peaks (campaigns, news cycles) and drops (broken nav, downtime).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(`accessDate`, $__interval) AS time,
  CASE WHEN m.`numFound` = 0 THEN 'no results' ELSE 'with results' END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Search volume over time

panels.description: Searches grouped by SN site. Helps see which corners of the catalog get the most attention.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.`name` AS site, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY s.`name`
ORDER BY searches DESC

panels.title: Searches by site

panels.description:
Funnel proxy from search-engine signals only (no click tracking yet). Drop between stages reveals where users hit a wall:

• Search issued — every query received
• Got any results — numFound > 0
• Got focused results — numFound between 1 and 50 (browsable, not overwhelming)
• Likely good answer — numFound between 1 and 10 (top page is probably enough)

A cliff between Stage 1 and Stage 2 is content gap. A cliff between Stage 3 and Stage 4 is a relevance/ranking issue (results exist but the user has to wade through hundreds).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT stage, count FROM (
  SELECT '1. Search issued'        AS stage, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2. Got any results'      AS stage, 2 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '3. Got focused results'  AS stage, 3 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '4. Likely good answer'   AS stage, 4 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 1 AND 10
) t
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Search funnel (proxy from numFound)

panels.description: Terms with the largest jump in volume between the most recent half of the time range and the half before it. Surfaces emerging interests, viral content, and recent campaigns. New terms (no prior occurrences) are highlighted with prev=0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AS lo,
         FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())   AS hi
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT b.lo, b.hi,
         FROM_UNIXTIME(($__unixEpochFrom() + $__unixEpochTo()) DIV 2) AS mid
  FROM bounds b
)
SELECT
  m.`sanatizedTerm` AS term,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` >= w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` <  w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` >= w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` <  w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delta,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` <  w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` >= w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` <  w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
          / SUM(CASE WHEN m.`accessDate` <  w.mid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  END AS growth
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
CROSS JOIN windowed w
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL AND m.`sanatizedTerm` <> ''
GROUP BY m.`sanatizedTerm`
HAVING delta > 0
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Trending terms (recent half vs prior half)

panels.description: Top 25 most popular search terms. Includes count, distinct users, and average results returned. Low avg results on a popular term = high-impact content gap. Click a term to drill down into its detailed timeline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  m.`sanatizedTerm` AS term,
  COUNT(*) AS searches,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`userId`, ''), CONCAT('anon-', m.id))) AS users,
  ROUND(AVG(m.`numFound`), 1) AS avg_results,
  COALESCE(c.clicks, 0) AS clicks,
  COALESCE(c.clicks, 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ctr,
  ROUND(c.avg_pos, 1) AS avg_click_pos
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT cc.`sanatizedTerm` AS term, COUNT(*) AS clicks, AVG(cc.`position`) AS avg_pos
  FROM sn_site_metric_click cc
  JOIN sn_site ss ON ss.id = cc.sn_site_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(cc.`accessDate`)
    AND ('$site' = 'All' OR ss.`name` = '$site')
    AND cc.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL AND cc.`sanatizedTerm` <> ''
  GROUP BY cc.`sanatizedTerm`
) c ON c.term = m.`sanatizedTerm`
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL AND m.`sanatizedTerm` <> ''
GROUP BY m.`sanatizedTerm`, c.clicks, c.avg_pos
ORDER BY searches DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top 25 search terms

panels.description: Terms that returned zero results, ranked by frequency. This is the highest-leverage list — every entry is a user looking for something the site doesn't surface. Click a term to drill down.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  m.`sanatizedTerm` AS term,
  COUNT(*) AS miss_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`userId`, ''), CONCAT('anon-', m.id))) AS distinct_users,
  MAX(m.`accessDate`) AS last_seen
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  AND m.`numFound` = 0
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL AND m.`sanatizedTerm` <> ''
GROUP BY m.`sanatizedTerm`
ORDER BY miss_count DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top 25 zero-result terms (content gap)

panels.description: Distribution of result-set sizes. A bulge at the 0 bucket means the catalog is leaving demand on the table; a long tail past 100 means the user often gets 'too many' and may need better facets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket, searches FROM (
  SELECT '0 (zero)' AS bucket, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '1' AS bucket, 2 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2-10' AS bucket, 3 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 2 AND 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '11-100' AS bucket, 4 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 11 AND 100
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '101-1000' AS bucket, 5 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` BETWEEN 101 AND 1000
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '1000+' AS bucket, 6 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND m.`numFound` > 1000
) t
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Result-size distribution

panels.description: Distribution of searches by language tag (Locale). Reveals where translation/content investment matters most.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`language`, ''), 'unknown') AS lang, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY m.`language`
ORDER BY searches DESC

panels.title: Searches by language

panels.description: Hour of the day vs day of the week. Bright cells are peak demand windows — useful for capacity planning, content rollout timing, and notification scheduling.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ELT(DAYOFWEEK(m.`accessDate`), 'Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat') AS dow,
  HOUR(m.`accessDate`) AS hour,
  COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
GROUP BY dow, hour
ORDER BY FIELD(dow, 'Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'), hour

panels.title: Search activity heatmap (hour × day-of-week)

panels.description: Most active known users. Useful for spotting power users, automated scripts, or single-user spikes that distort aggregates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.`userId` AS user, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  AND m.`userId` IS NOT NULL AND m.`userId` <> ''
GROUP BY m.`userId`
ORDER BY searches DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top users by search volume

panels.description: Average term length per day. A rising trend often signals frustration (users adding more keywords because they aren't finding what they want).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(m.`accessDate`, '1d') AS time,
  AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(m.`sanatizedTerm`)) AS avg_length,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(m.`sanatizedTerm`)) AS max_length
FROM sn_site_metric_access m
JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`)
  AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  AND m.`sanatizedTerm` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Term length over time (proxy for user frustration)

panels.description: Where in the result page users actually click. A heavy bias toward positions 1-3 means the top results are doing their job; clicks deep in the tail (positions 10+) suggest ranking is off — relevant content is buried. Compare to {turing.search.calls} latency to ensure the cost of fetching extra pages is justified.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket, clicks FROM (
  SELECT '1'      AS bucket, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS clicks FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2'      AS bucket, 2 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` = 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '3'      AS bucket, 3 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` = 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '4-5'    AS bucket, 4 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` BETWEEN 4 AND 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '6-10'   AS bucket, 5 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` BETWEEN 6 AND 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '11-25'  AS bucket, 6 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` BETWEEN 11 AND 25
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '25+'    AS bucket, 7 AS ord, COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site') AND c.`position` > 25
) t
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Click position distribution (scroll fatigue)

panels.description: Searches and clicks per day side-by-side, with the resulting CTR. CTR is clicks ÷ searches in the same day — useful for spotting periods where the catalog stopped serving demand even though traffic kept coming.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, label AS metric, value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(m.`accessDate`, '1d') AS day, 'searches' AS label, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value
  FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  GROUP BY day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeGroup(c.`accessDate`, '1d') AS day, 'clicks' AS label, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value
  FROM sn_site_metric_click c JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = c.sn_site_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
  GROUP BY day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT day, 'ctr' AS label, COALESCE(clicks_count / NULLIF(searches_count, 0), 0) AS value
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(m.`accessDate`, '1d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS searches_count,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_site_metric_click c2
            JOIN sn_site s2 ON s2.id = c2.sn_site_id
            WHERE $__timeGroup(c2.`accessDate`, '1d') = $__timeGroup(m.`accessDate`, '1d')
              AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s2.`name` = '$site')) AS clicks_count
    FROM sn_site_metric_access m JOIN sn_site s ON s.id = m.sn_site_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(m.`accessDate`) AND ('$site' = 'All' OR s.`name` = '$site')
    GROUP BY day
  ) sub
) all_metrics
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Searches vs clicks vs CTR (daily)

list.definition: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT `name`, `name` FROM sn_site ORDER BY 1
